## Today's learning {#ss4-objective .ar-lesson }

### Lesson objective

Understand how constant differences lead to arithmetic-series formulas and models of linear growth and decay.

### Success criteria

I can calculate arithmetic partial sums and distinguish a quantity at a particular time from an accumulated total.

::: notes

Assume students are comfortable with function notation, sequence notation, recursive rules, the arithmetic general term and summation notation. Connect to Lessons 2 and 3 without repeating input/output instruction.

:::
